ios.desc:
Tile Soccer is a unique global platform, aimed to unite football fans from all over the globe and gather them in one perfect place.

In Tile Soccer, users and their actions define everything, and that is why every true football fan is going to love it. We have made our best to make it happen with the whole new product that will constantly evolve and get new features day-by-day. 

Find new friends, catch latest news, discuss hottest transfers, find football matches in your city, share memes, watch games live, play simulators together, predict results, share videos, explore statistics and much, much more. 

We have always dreamt to make a product that will become a number one source for every soccer fan in the world, and we are happy to present it to you now.

Football is finally coming home! Let us celebrate together!
